text:
Erin (Finance): Quick escalation - Savant AI (SVT-918) invoice INV-2025-3321 is 14 days overdue for $48,600. They just asked to split into 3 installments. Card retry failed with AVS mismatch. Thoughts?
Mateo (AM): They're actively using prod. Customer emailed asking for breathing room; willing to sign. I'll confirm PO and ask for payment method update.
Priya (CS): Paste of their message: "Cashflow hiccup this quarter. Can we do 3 equal payments? We'll sign whatever's needed."
Jamal (Payments): I retried card at 2024-05-02T09:14Z - gateway returned DECLINE_AVS_MISMATCH. Logged attempt_id=pay_8f3b2. Recommend asking for new card or ACH.
payments-bot: PaymentAttempt failed for INV-2025-3321, amount=48600, reason=DECLINE_AVS_MISMATCH, attempt_id=pay_8f3b2
Erin (Finance): Per collections policy for >$30k, require >=30% upfront. We can authorize 30/35/35 with signed agreement + card on file. Manager exception needed for anything softer.
Chloe (Collections): Agree. I'll prepare the payment plan terms. If they miss the first payment window (7 days), escalate to legal + collections hold.
Mateo (AM): Customer prefers 25% upfront but says they can move to 30% if necessary. They'll sign today if we give them a link.
Erin (Finance): OK: conditions - 30% immediate charge, signed payment plan in SF, card token stored, billing flagged so invoice doesn't auto-collect. Priya, can you get the token and signed doc?
Priya (CS): Reached out to customer and asked for new card or ACH routing. They replied: "We can charge new card for 30% now and upload signed agreement EOD." Sending them the DocuSign link.
Jamal (Payments): I'll hold retries until we get new payment info. If they provide ACH I'll allow a single manual push once routing/routing verification is done.
Priya (CS): Customer posted token (redacted) tok_live_9q3h...
payments-bot: ManualCharge started attempt_id=pay_8f3b3 amount=14580 for INV-2025-3321
payments-bot: ManualCharge succeeded attempt_id=pay_8f3b3 status=SUCCEEDED txn=txn_7a1c
Jamal (Payments): Charge went through. Updating ledger and marking invoice status to "partial paid - on payment plan". I'll schedule the two remaining invoices at 30 days and 60 days.
Chloe (Collections): Set Asana COL-4421, reminder on 2024-06-05 for second installment. If not received, escalate.
Erin (Finance): I'll update Salesforce: add note, attach signed agreement, annotate invoice with plan terms. I'll also keep billing from auto-sending dunning notices while plan is active.
Mateo (AM): Customer confirmed DocuSign signed and PO attached. They thanked us.
Priya (CS): Closing loop from CS.
Erin (Finance): Thanks team. If the second payment fails, Chloe and I will take next steps. Thread closed unless further issues. :white_check_mark:
